_doc: KĀLA-YANTRA fixed-operation table (charter §7). The executor reads THIS FILE FROM origin/main (never from a working tree) and refuses any kind not listed or not enabled. `enabled_by` names the item an entry serves; campaign builders never edit this file; open: enablement path. FORMAT RULE: `enabled` is the FIRST key of every entry — the plan model's detectors read it. `script` is a repository-relative path; a read-only operation's script is extracted from origin/main; a production operation runs in a private worktree at the request's reviewed_commit (which must be merged). `fixed_args` are always passed; `allowed_args` are the request-arg keys that may be appended as --key value; `needs` is the capability; `requesters` are the lanes that may request the kind (default: adhikarin only); optional `cwd` (repository-relative), `python_module` (run as python -m) and `timeout_s`. `required_rows` names the checklist rows the verifier's acceptance receipt must attest true for a mutating run of that kind. Gochara authority operations (verification_job, publish_head, rollback_head) and whole-layer operations (layer_verify, layer_publish, layer_rollback) are different surfaces and never substitute for each other. Wave 4 preparation: also_needs requires every additional capability; prepared_dry_run is disabled review metadata, never an executor kind or a dry_run_passed attestation. New kinds require a real child and phase review before enablement. `cloudrun_job_readback` (J-2a, read-only, production:false) measures the deployed pipeline Cloud Run job's image, digest, commit tag and configuration and, with the optional `execution` argument, that execution's completion and, with `logs` (valid only beside `execution`; value `true`), one fixed `gcloud logging read` of that execution's job log parsed for STRETCH_SINK/1 lines and asset.substep progress (SR-J3-READ-KINDS); it emits ky.cloudrun_readback/1 (fleet/CLOUDRUN_READBACK_v1_0.md). `read_only: true` (A7 D-44) marks a kind whose COMPLETED exit-0 run the executor itself accepts mechanically (acceptance/<op>.post.json, by executor-mechanical; no reviewer). `quiescence_check` (read-only) reads the live sessions that carry a fenced operation's PGAPPNAME marker; on request the executor then measures that operation's quiescence and, only if every check holds, writes acceptance/<op>.quiescence.json (by executor-mechanical). A mechanical record is never a pre-acceptance of a writing operation (validate still requires v1..v4). `scheduler_pause` / `scheduler_resume` (+ `*_dryrun`) and the read-only `scheduler_readback` (SR-J3-REAPER-PAUSE, enabled_by J-3c) act on ONE Cloud Scheduler job, `watchdog-reaper` (fleet/scheduler_reaper.py; any other job is refused); a pause must name `resume-by` (UTC, not after its lease end) and the executor arms a durable resume record the loop honours on every tick, restarts included (executor.py scheduler_backstop_*); each receipt carries the job state read back after the action. `measuring_cancel` (SR-J3-CANCEL-NULL, enabled_by J-3c) cancels ONE running execution of the measuring build (fleet/measuring_cancel.py) and only when admission binds the target to the execution named in the cited measuring_dispatch receipt and an ABORT/stall verdict file is cited by sha256; the receipt carries the execution state read back after the cancel (anything but CANCELLED is FAILED); it is never held by the production fence; `measuring_cancel_dryrun` checks the same admission and makes no cloud call. `century_dispatch` (SR-PREBUILD-ALL, item J-4e, enabled_by J-4d) stages the FINAL ordinary candidate run of ka_gochara_v5 — the measuring launch without the test slice: NO slice marker, trigger gochara-v5-century, no horizon or class choice (the writer decides) — then launches exactly that staged run through the same durable no-retry claim (fleet/century_launch.py; builder + gcloud). `century_dispatch_dryrun` (production:false) runs the same staging and ROLLS BACK, printing the plan and the one Cloud Run launch it would make (ky.century_staging/1); the real kind demands its receipt. `century_teardown_dryrun` / `century_teardown` (SR-TEARDOWN-AUTHORITY-GATE item 3) reuse the scoped teardown with a century_scope run_id scope for century-candidate rows; `century_teardown` stays enabled:false until an owner authority naming century candidate rows (OWNER-AUTH-TEARDOWN-v2) is recorded and teardown_gate reads it.
